verses.text: A Psalm of David. O LORD, hear my prayer. In Your faithfulness, give ear to my plea; in Your righteousness, answer me.

segments.text: A Psalm of David. O LORD, hear my prayer. In Your faithfulness, give ear to my plea; in Your righteousness, answer me.

verses.text: Do not bring Your servant into judgment, for no one alive is righteous before You.

segments.text: Do not bring Your servant into judgment, for no one alive is righteous before You.

verses.text: For the enemy has pursued my soul, crushing my life to the ground, making me dwell in darkness like those long since dead.

segments.text: For the enemy has pursued my soul, crushing my life to the ground, making me dwell in darkness like those long since dead.

verses.text: My spirit grows faint within me; my heart is dismayed inside me.

segments.text: My spirit grows faint within me; my heart is dismayed inside me.

verses.text: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all Your works; I consider the work of Your hands.

segments.text: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all Your works; I consider the work of Your hands.

verses.text: I stretch out my hands to You; my soul thirsts for You like a parched land. Selah

segments.text: I stretch out my hands to You; my soul thirsts for You like a parched land. Selah

verses.text: Answer me quickly, O LORD; my spirit fails. Do not hide Your face from me, or I will be like those who descend to the Pit.

segments.text: Answer me quickly, O LORD; my spirit fails. Do not hide Your face from me, or I will be like those who descend to the Pit.

verses.text: Let me hear Your loving devotion in the morning, for I have put my trust in You. Teach me the way I should walk, for to You I lift up my soul.

segments.text: Let me hear Your loving devotion in the morning, for I have put my trust in You. Teach me the way I should walk, for to You I lift up my soul.

verses.text: Deliver me from my enemies, O LORD; I flee to You for refuge.

segments.text: Deliver me from my enemies, O LORD; I flee to You for refuge.

verses.text: Teach me to do Your will, for You are my God. May Your good Spirit lead me on level ground.

segments.text: Teach me to do Your will, for You are my God. May Your good Spirit lead me on level ground.

verses.text: For the sake of Your name, O LORD, revive me. In Your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble.

segments.text: For the sake of Your name, O LORD, revive me. In Your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble.

verses.text: And in Your loving devotion, cut off my enemies. Destroy all who afflict me, for I am Your servant.

segments.text: And in Your loving devotion, cut off my enemies. Destroy all who afflict me, for I am Your servant.
